The subset sum confirms there are exactly two ways to compose 9,000,000 paise:
1. INV-00128 alone (current explanation)
2. INV-00214 alone (alternative option)

While the payment notes mention "Ira Nair" (which matches INV-00128's customer), the payment could legitimately be for INV-00214 (Meera Bhat). The notes might be metadata from the payment link description rather than definitive evidence of customer identity. Since both invoices have identical amounts and both are open/unreconciled, this represents a valid alternative explanation.

The pattern would still be "partial_payment" since the description indicates "Fee payment link" and the invoice dates (INV-00214 issued 2026-09-09, payment captured 2026-09-14) also align reasonably.

input.rationale: Payment amount 9,000,000 paise exactly matches invoice INV-00214 (customer CUST00184, Meera Bhat). Both candidate invoices (INV-00128 and INV-00214) have identical amounts, making either attribution arithmetically valid.
